body:
With build-file (domain 5) now real and callable, actually tried
compiling a piece of PARENA's own self-hosting pipeline through
itself for the first time: build-file "selfhost/lexer.prn" ... .
It segfaulted.

Root cause, confirmed live via a real gdb backtrace: emit-let-bindings
called emit-alloc-call unconditionally on every let-binding's expr
node with no check it was actually an alloc call. lexer.prn's own
first real let-binding, (let [lx0 (selfhost/lexer/new-lexer src)]
...), is a plain function call -- a genuine, in-scope PARENA shape
this narrow v0 emitter never claimed to support. vec/get's own honest
out-of-bounds convention returns NULL, but emit-alloc-call then did a
bare get-field on that NULL with no check, crashing at the C level.

Fixed with a real alloc-call-shaped? guard in selfhost/emit.prn: a
non-alloc-shaped binding now emits a clean C #error line instead of
crashing -- verified to make a subsequent gcc compile fail with a
real, comprehensible diagnostic (exit 1) rather than crash anything.
3 new regression assertions in tests/test_selfhost_emit.c (13 total
for domain 4). Full local suite (336 tests) + all 5 selfhost domains +
real mingw cross-compile clean, zero regressions. CI green on all 4
jobs, confirmed via the Actions API.

Honest, complete picture: selfhost/lexer.prn still does not actually
compile through the selfhost pipeline -- the crash is gone, but the
resulting C fails a real gcc compile with dozens of genuine, expected
errors (undeclared struct-typed tail identifiers, void returns in
non-Unit functions), all symptoms of the same already-documented,
much bigger gap: no match/loop/recur/arithmetic/closures/Vec-Map-
generics support in the narrow v0 selfhost emitter, and no real
argv/main emission convention anywhere in parena-c yet. This was never
expected to make a real self-compile succeed -- the real, scoped value
here was turning a crash into an honest, diagnosable failure, matching
the bar every other domain in this effort already holds itself to.
NORTHSTAR.md's own "Self-hosting" section updated with the full
writeup, including this honest post-fix state.

PARENA commit 836e854. CI run 33095700044: all 4 jobs green.
